title: SCH-CNT-002 weapon stat price formula
description: The weapon common-ore stat upgrade price curve. The project-owned typed validator in src/MechaMiner.Content/Categories/ remains authoritative; this schema is the draft 2020-12 mirror kept for editor and tool interoperability, and a fixture corpus proves the two reach the same accept/reject verdict on every structural case. See content/schemas/README.md. It stays in content/weapons/ because the price curve is a shared rule within the weapon domain, the same reasoning that keeps the shared elite modifier profile in content/enemies/. Every price table the authored file carried was an output of the formula and is recomputed by the price-curve report.

id.title: A stable, case-sensitive ASCII content ID

formula_kind.description: The registered formula kind. Doc 40 requires a registered kind plus parameters rather than an arbitrary script string, so there is no field here that accepts an expression. A lower-kebab-case token. Whether it resolves to exactly one registered behavior descriptor is the behavior registry's check and is deliberately not asserted here.

currency_resource_id.description: The resource the price is paid in.

parameters.title: A registry-owned parameter map
parameters.description: The formula's parameters, keyed by its kind. The key vocabulary belongs to the registered behavior descriptor rather than to this schema, so keys are not enumerated here; the strict codec still rejects a null, a duplicate key, and a non-snake_case key inside one.

version.title: A positive integer version
version.description: The initial schema_version and content_version of every first-authored definition is 1.

minimum.derivation: the initial value of every first-authored definition is 1 and both versions only ever increment, so no valid version is below 1; there is no upper bound because a definition may be revised without limit

name_key.title: Localization key for the player-facing name

summary_key.title: Localization key for the concise player-facing summary

tags.title: Closed query and tooling vocabulary
tags.description: The vocabulary starts empty, so [] is the only accepted value.

presentation_id.title: Logical presentation entry, required absent
presentation_id.description: Required absent: a definition carrying this field is an error. No accepted document says what a presentation definition contains, so no ID grammar has been minted for one, and minting a shape for a category with zero members would be inventing structure ahead of need. The field was declared-optional with a non-empty-string constraint, which accepted any string an author invented and validated nothing about it; rejecting the field outright fails loudly the first time somebody adds one instead of accepting an unauthorized value. The subschema is 'not' over the empty schema, which rejects every instance, so the fault is the field's presence rather than its shape and an authored empty string is rejected by the same rule rather than as an empty declared-optional field. The typed validator reports MMC-2010 and names the field. When an accepted document mints a presentation ID grammar, this declaration becomes that grammar; until then it has no minLength, because a length bound on a value that can never be authored explains nothing.
